annotations.title: Read a Desk pick’s Grade report

description: The full Grade report behind one Desk pick’s letter (GET desk/report), the same report the app opens from the pick: {version, pickId, grade {letter, score, jobId}, report}. Use a pickId from get_desk whose grade.report is true. Desk plan and up only (desk_plan_required for Free, Starter and Pro); desk_pick_not_found for an unknown pick, desk_report_not_ready while the pick has no finished Grade. Reads only.
name: get_desk_report
